Sample.evidence_source: The paper discusses 'negative affect' as a predictor of body image concerns, but does not provide descriptive statistics (N, Mean, SD) for negative affect or any other SWB component as an outcome variable across waves.

yearT1.evidence_source: The paper's DOI (10.1016/j.adolescence.2008.08.002) indicates a publication year of 2008. The study is longitudinal over 'nine months' [/page/11/Text/10]. Using the rule 'publication_year − study_duration', 2008 - 0.75 years = 2007.25, rounded to 2007 for the first wave.
yearT1.warning: Year T1 is estimated from publication year and study duration as no explicit T1 year was stated.

country.evidence_source: [/page/11/Text/9] 'adolescents living in the People's Republic of China'

Outcome_variable.evidence_source: The study focuses on 'predictors of changes in body image concerns' [/page/11/Text/9], 'body dissatisfaction' [/page/11/Text/9], 'appearance or weight esteem' [/page/11/Text/9], and 'stature dissatisfaction' [/page/14/Text/4]. While 'negative affect' is mentioned, it is described as a 'predictor' [/page/11/Text/9], not an outcome variable of subjective well-being.
Outcome_variable.warning: The study's outcome variables are related to body image, not subjective well-being (life satisfaction, positive affect, negative affect).

sample_type.evidence_source: [/page/14/Text/5] 'sampling was limited to Southwest China and there were under-representations of Han majority participants and males in addition to an over-representation of adolescents enrolled in senior high school'

ethnicity.warning: The text states 'under-representations of Han majority participants', implying that the Han majority does not constitute 70% or more of the sample, and no other single group is identified as predominant.
